body: Separate enforcement work deferred by FEAT-2452. branch-create-gate.py trusts nonempty stdout without checking the issue-read return code; a nonzero command with output can therefore be accepted as verified state. merge-gate.py falls back to the local branch when its remote head read fails; a merge verdict can therefore be reached on unverified state. Plan an enforcement-layer repair and independent regression tests for each condition under DEC-100, DEC-144 and DEC-174. Do not change either executor, its GH_BIN, check_state/ctx auth, or timeout policy in FEAT-2452. Issues 588 and 846 remain separate and open.
title: Enforcement GitHub reads must not trust unverified state
